note: Majority: the Civil Transactions Law issued by Royal Decree 29/2013, article 41: a person of sound mind not under interdiction who has reached majority has full capacity, and majority is the completion of eighteen years. Work: the Labour Law issued by Royal Decree 53/2023, article 98: a juvenile of either sex may not be employed or let into a workplace before fifteen, and the Minister may raise that age for some industries; juveniles may not work between 6 p.m. and 6 a.m. or more than six hours a day (article 99), which isn't held. The law makes no exception for performers, so the form holds them barred below fifteen (my reading: the law names no permit and no exemption). Service: no conscription law was found on Qanoon.om's collection of Omani legislation, and no Ministry of Defence page was read; service is left null. Texts read from Qanoon.om, a private site reproducing the Official Gazette's texts, on 2026-10-31.
